file_insights.changes_made: Refactored to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter handling
file_insights.complexity_reduction: Replaced 28 lines of manual filtering/pagination logic with 12 lines of declarative filter configuration
key_changes: Removed inline Q object filter construction
Removed manual Paginator instantiation and pagination logic
Added FilterConfig objects for declarative filter definition
Replaced manual filter application with apply_list_filters utility call

patterns_discovered.description: FilterConfig objects define filters declaratively with param_name, filter_type, and filter_kwargs/search_fields
patterns_discovered.benefit: Centralized, reusable filter definitions that reduce code duplication

patterns_discovered.description: Migration from imperative filtering logic to declarative configuration passed to apply_list_filters utility
patterns_discovered.benefit: Standardized approach across views, easier maintenance, reduced boilerplate

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns dict with 'queryset' and 'filter_values' keys for easy template context building
patterns_discovered.benefit: Consistent result structure across all views using this utility

patterns_discovered.description: Preserved database optimization with select_related and prefetch_related in base queryset

gotchas_discovered.description: Filter values moved from direct request.GET extraction to result['filter_values'].get()
gotchas_discovered.impact: Template context must access values from new structure; changes required in corresponding template

gotchas_discovered.description: Pagination logic completely hidden inside apply_list_filters utility; page_size hardcoded to 20
gotchas_discovered.impact: No granular control over pagination beyond the utility's implementation; assumptions about page parameter naming

gotchas_discovered.description: Search fields specified as strings ('warehouse__code') rather than ORM constructs
gotchas_discovered.impact: Typos in field names won't be caught until runtime; relies on utility to correctly parse ORM paths

gotchas_discovered.description: Statistics queries still perform full counts on entire InventoryCount table, not filtered subset
gotchas_discovered.impact: Stats don't reflect current filtered results; potential performance issue with large tables

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully refactored inventory_count_list view to use apply_list_filters utility, reducing manual filter/pagination code by ~50%
approach_outcome.completion: First attempt completed successfully; no iterations needed
approach_outcome.code_quality: Improved through standardization and reduced boilerplate; now follows established pattern across codebase
approach_outcome.maintainability: Enhanced via centralized filter configuration and utility-based implementation
approach_outcome.performance: Maintained through preserved select_related/prefetch_related; statistics query optimization opportunity missed

recommendations.recommendation: Update corresponding template to use new result dictionary structure (result['filter_values']) instead of individual context variables
Refactor statistics queries to use filtered queryset instead of recounting entire table independently
Consider using constants or enums for search field names to catch naming errors at development time
Document FilterConfig pattern and apply_list_filters utility behavior (pagination defaults, filter_values structure) for consistent adoption across views
Audit other list views in codebase to identify candidates for similar refactoring to apply_list_filters utility
